settings.heading: The suede
settings.content: Brown, cut full, and soft enough to take the shape of a day. It will mark where your life marks it.

settings.heading: The scarf
settings.content: A flowered scarf, knotted at the handle, with a small tag hanging from the knot. It is the bag's piece of jewelry.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Made when you claim it, then sent the long way on purpose. Gracious, calm returns within 30 days — write to the house and we'll sort it.

settings.preorder_fulfillment: A preorder, charged today at [price]. Packed carefully by the house and sent the long way when it's ready. Nothing here waits in a warehouse.
settings.preorder_eyebrow: Preorder · Edition I · In Her Purse
settings.more_text: The edition fills up slowly, on purpose. The letter tells you first.
